podcast.body: The title track from his 1974 album, this gentle country two-step served as the follow-up to "Annie's Song." It was Denver's first hit to perform better on the country chart than on the pop chart, reaching number one country and number five pop. "It became John's first hit to do better on the country chart than on the pop chart."
